provinceSource.note: The 1300 source contains 237 historical political/cultural GIS features. Historia AI imports them as provisional Province simulation units; they must not be described as a complete historically exact administrative-province dataset.

notes: Historical borders are approximate and source-dependent.
Province is Historia AI's runtime simulation unit; it is not a claim that every imported feature was an administrative province in 1300.
The generated source GeoJSON remains a local build artifact unless redistribution is explicitly permitted by the source license.
